reviews.text: The staff at Lakewood Veterinary Clinic is friendly and professional. Dr. Wright has been my veterinarian for many years now. LVC provides excellent care for your pets,

I recently adopted my new pup Challah and reached out to Lakewood for preventative care for flea, tick and heartworm care. I’d tried several other veterinarians in area previously with my indoor cat and didn’t feel as though they cared for my cat as much as they cared for the bottom line cost. The Lakewood staff showed genuine care, attention and love to my new household addition and took the time to explain my options of care for Challah. My timid little pup immediately fell in love with them and made her feel at ease. I’ve already recommended this amazing vet to others.

We had a great experience at Lakewood Veterinary Center. Everyone we interacted with was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and informative. They took the time to explain everything clearly, answer all of our questions, and never made us feel rushed. Most importantly, you could tell how genuinely loving and caring the entire staff was with our dog. She was treated like their own, which made us feel completely comfortable having her in their care. We’re very happy we found Lakewood VetCenter and would absolutely recommend them to anyone looking for a knowledgeable and compassionate veterinary team.

We had a great experience with Dr. Merrill and Ximena! They were both very thorough and compassionate with our pup. Dr. Merrill was very genuine and despite the office being busy gave us her full attention and answered all of our questions without feeling rushed. We love Lakewood Vet and will remain with them as long as we live in Dallas. Plus our pup LOVES going to their office!

Absolutely no compassion.
I’m not sure what has changed in the vet world but they are no longer helping animals. They are over pricing EVERYTHING.

Going to Lakewood Vet has been an amazing experience! My cat has bad anxiety when it comes to going to the vet and they are always calm, supportive and accommodating to him to make sure he gets the best care possible. I also appreciate how they don't order unnecessary testing which has made going here very affordable for the quality of care that you get!
Excellent service. Knowledgeable, evidence based, and caring. Felt like your very own neighborhood vet. Happy to have found Dr. Wright
Dr. Wright really listened and took his time to help my cat without putting him through a bunch of unnecessary testing.
They always take the best care of our babies and answer all of our questions thoroughly and thoughtfully!
Thank you!
Dr. Wright and staff are very caring and thorough. They take such good care of my babies!
Always have a great experience here with all the staff including Dr. Brooke being so kind, efficient and wonderful. Our dog legit loves going to the vet here.

Always the best experience. They are kind people with genuine care for your pet and for your needs. Trust is something they can easily gain because of their integrity and kindness.

If you have a pet and want to go somewhere that prioritizes their wellbeing, look no further.

Wish I can give it a zero , my pet bunny was brought in almost a month ago because he had an abscess and I love him so much , we did a surgery or so she said , looked like lancing to me , paid 500 and she said it cleaned 50 percent of abscess , I followed the medical treatment and now the bunny have another abscess , she told me one of her options is 4K surgery or put him thru death , a terrible clinic for sure and terrible vet who don’t care about animals
Lakewood Vet takes great care of my pup.  He is a very nervous/anxious dog and they are very sweet & patient with him.  Everyone who works here is so kind.
we wouldn't dream of taking our dog anywhere else!
Love the technicians here, love the receptionists here, and love the doctors here!

Everyone there is amazing and seem like they care a lot. I took my dog for the first time there and they took care of us right away and explained to us in detail how to care for him at home. I recommend this place 100% everyone there is so sweet!
Everyone was very pleasant and helpful. It was a great experience for a first appointment with a new vet.
They always get us in so quickly and the staff is so nice! Our dog gets a little scared at the vet and they are so good with her and make her and us comfortable!
Thank you!
We love Dr Wright & his staff. I feel confident that they are caring for my boys with compassion & they are receiving the appropriate care.

Had my cat and dog treated there and the doctor truly cares and the whole team there are awesome. They are greatly priced compared to others I've been to. Overall best vet around. Thanks from David & Oscar

I want to thank Lakewood Vet Center for the excellent care they provided for our sweet dog Kaya. This is such a fantastic clinic and we enjoyed our many routine visits. I want to especially thank one of the vet techs, Bedford, for the compassion and care he showed for both Kaya and me during our final moments together earlier this week.

We love Lakewood Vet Center. We have been bringing Charlie and Olive and they care for them so much even our Charlie boy who can be unpredictable. They are very patient and provide the best care. 5 stars but would give more if I could!
Dr Wright and his entire staff are fantastic! 5 Star customer service and I'm grateful for the way they take care of my doodle and me. Highly recommend this team for your fur babies.
Love Dr Wright and so does my fox terrier, Daisy. He’s always been there for my dogs.
Muffin has been going here for 15 years! I attribure her good health to the quality of care that she has received here.!

I brought my senior pup here for the first time last week and have been treated with utmost care and support. While the services are a bit more expensive in my experience, it is worth it to be treated with care for my fur baby.

Updating review due to new information. The communication issue seemed to be a tech hiccup and unrelated to their impeccable service:

Dr. Wright and the team at Lakewood Veterinary Center went above and beyond during one of the most difficult times of my life.

My cat was in kidney failure, and Dr. Wright helped us every step of the way,  from teaching us how to administer subcutaneous fluids at home to carefully managing her pain for over a year. He was patient, compassionate, and always made sure we understood how to keep her as comfortable as possible.

What meant the most was that he gave us clear, kind guidance about what to expect as her condition progressed. When the time came, we were able to make sure she passed peacefully, calmly, and with dignity — and that was only possible because of his support and detailed instructions.

Losing a pet is devastating, but having a vet who genuinely cares and takes the time to help you prepare makes all the difference. I will always be grateful for the care we received here. Thank you, Dr. Wright, for helping us give our girl the most loving goodbye we could.
Love this vet! We just moved here to Dallas and were very concerned about finding the most reliable, friendly, compete, and caring vet for our fur babies. Nailed it!!

We recently moved to the area and one our dogs became extremely ill. Lakewood Veterinary Center has the kindest staff who immediately jumped to help our sweet boy. They are knowledgeable, caring and we are thankful to have a new, great vet close by!
We love Lakewood Vet & have been taking our sweet golden retriever here for 3 years. They are the best & couldn’t recommend them more!
Thank you!
I loved the staff. They treated my baby and me so well and took care of him. They truly care and have a kind/loving approach which made my anxious fur baby feel much more comfortable.

My dog has anxiety and gets stressed when going to the vet (but then again, what dog LOVES going to the vet?). I have come here the past three years and they prescribed my dog Trazadone to help calm her prior to visits. Trazadone is given in multiple doses starting two days before the visit.

Today, I brought my dog in for her vaccines and annual check up. I had given my dog Trazadone two days ago, yesterday, and this morning. The vet tech came in, asked the usual probing questions (what food is she eating, what heartworm medication, etc.). After, I asked the tech questions about my dog's evening panting, sometimes strange eating schedule, etc. which he was unable to answer fully and said he would ask the doctor. He then brought my dog to the back to see the doctors.

A few minutes later one of the doctors comes out and tells me they cannot give my dog the vaccines because my dog is too nervous and then she tells me they will be prescribing my dog additional medicine (on top of the Trazadone) for her anxiety. The doctor does not tell me anything about my dog's health condition or answer the questions that the vet tech allegedly wrote down and said he would ask her.

Despite not doing anything to my dog, I am charged a $100 visit fee and the cost of the new medicine. I call back 30 min after I leave to reschedule an appointment for next week and bring up my opinion that I should not be charged a second visit fee for the follow up. Lakewood Vet Center does not seem to agree. They say I will have to pay another $100 visit fee next time I come in even though I paid it today. This is not good business.

EDIT 7/2 -the hospital manager and owner both reached out professionally and apologized for the inconvenience and offered a refund of the visit which is appreciated.

Lakewood Vet Center provided me with excellent customer care! I appreciate Ximena's patience and understanding as I was researching local vets for my dog's care. Highy recommend as a professional and courteous vet care clinic.
Thank you!
Thank you!
Thank you for trusting us with your fur babies!
Thank you for being an amazing long-time client!

For the past 16 years—since he was just four months old—my dog Bexar, a Yorkie-Poodle mix, has been in the exceptional care of Dr. Wright and his team. I am incredibly grateful for their knowledge, skill, and unwavering dedication to the animals in the DFW community. The staff is always so kind and patient, especially as Bexar has gotten older. No matter the day, they are always just a call, email, or text away, providing comfort and support whenever we need it. Thank you for everything you do!

We absolutely love the Lakewood vet team! Everyone is so kind and caring and truly loves our pets as if they were their own - even our spicy meatball cat!! (thank you Deaven! lol) Dr. Wright is so knowledgeable and is great about referring out when he feels he needs to. I’ve never doubted that my pets are in the best hands here.  The team is in constant communication with us when our pets are there and I always leaving feeling informed and prepared. We’ll go here as long as we live in the DFW area. Thank you Lakewood team!
Always have had a great experience! Great customer service!

The staff here are really friendly and did a great job at our initial appointment.  While our dog, Eva Maria is not sick, we wanted her to see a veterinarian and know one ahead of time for normal check up’s and when she does get sick.  Highly recommend this veterinarian and their entire staff
They are very professional

I am proud to bring my dear puppy to Dr Wright at Lakewood Vet. Since she’s been a puppy all of the staff, techs, and Dr Wright has been caring and attentive to my puppy and have helped make sure she is properly cared for. I really like the office and location, but most of all I care about the quality of care and attention to my dog. I can only make the highest recommendation that your puppy will receive high quality, modern, and scientifically supported medical care here. Dr Wright’s patient explanations, calm and relaxed demeanor, and skill have served our family well. Thanks Dr Wright!
Thank you!

We brought in our puppy for his first check up since getting him and the staff was so loving towards our puppy and the vet came in quickly and explained how the process works, when check ups will need to happen and gave general advice on how to be successful in having a puppy. We would recommend this vet to anyone that is wanting to make sure your puppy is being cared for and have peace of mind leaving your animals in their care.
Very helpful and friendly. They go above and beyond to help.  You can tell they really care about your dogs!
Lakewood Veterinary Clinic is the best, and Dr. Wright is peerless in my experience.  Would fly from the coast to bring my French Bulldog Lila to LVC for her needs if that were required.
Best vet in town! Not a corporate chain, and the Drs and staff are exceptional.
The staff at Lakewood Vet are amazing!!  They are always friendly & informative.  they ALL go above & beyond.  Dr. Wright is Gods gift to animals.  I am so grateful for Lakewood Vet!!!

I cannot say enough positive things about this vet clinic. They are always so welcoming and professional with me and my dog Luke. The front desk staff is especially lovely and accommodating and the doctors are so caring (and patient) with my high energy pup.
Very helpful staff and we got seen quickly.
